cards.summary: Full-spectrum gradient across the word, left to right (in the thumbnail P is red to violet, G blue to teal, D green to yellow to orange), outlined by a thin black-and-white dashed line like marching ants (a 3 px outside stroke made from a banded two-colour gradient). The stored grey Color Overlay (#9b9a9a at 41%) sits above the gradient in Photoshop's overlay order, so every hue is softened: the red reads about #d63f47 and the blue about #405bd5 instead of pure #ff0000 / #0000ff. A different style also named Rainbow lives in the Buttons group of the same library. Effects stored in the style: Color Overlay, Gradient Overlay, Stroke.
use_for: pride, festival or carnival poster headline
avoid: small type: the dashed outline clutters letters under about 40 px
serious or corporate work: the rainbow plus marching-ants outline reads playful
light grounds: the yellow and cyan stretches lose contrast (inferred from the gradient colours)
do not confuse it with the Rainbow style in the Buttons group, which is a different look
cards.applies_to: a text, shape or pixel layer (not the locked Background layer: double-click it to unlock first). verified.note: Muted spectrum left to right (letter pixels about #d63f47 red, #405bd5 blue, #40d561 green, not pure hues) with a dashed black-white outline; the 41% grey Color Overlay renders above the Gradient Overlay and softens every hue.
